Hi Alice / Mike —

Great to be partnering with you for Aurora Health's rollout. To make the kickoff efficient, we've put together a short proposed agenda and a suggested attendee grid (roles vs sessions). Can you confirm the following so we can lock invites?

- Preferred kickoff window: Tuesday 14 Dec, 2:00–3:30 PM PST (we can adjust by +/- 1 hour)
- Primary technical contact for SSO/network/firewall checks
- Any external stakeholders who should be observers only (we'll mark "view only" on calendar)

I've attached a draft agenda (RDW_Kickoff_Agenda_v0.2.pdf). If the timing works, we'll send a calendar invite with the Zoom bridge and a short "prework" doc (1 page) listing accounts and access they should provision beforehand.

Proposed hosts: Soojin Lee (Redwood PM), Monica Patel (Customer Success). Ben Carter will cover orientation and operational runbooks.

Thanks — can you reply with confirmed attendee names + titles and any blackout times?

Best,
Soojin Lee
